context: Sho tells Grandma about a fun mishap.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (取る/困っ/回っ/ちゃい/底) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、コマを回して遊んだよ!
lines.en: Grandma, I played by spinning a top!
lines.style: excited small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.en: Oh my, did it spin well?
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、でも箱の底に落ちちゃい困ったの。
lines.en: Yeah, but it fell to the bottom of the box, and I was stuck.
lines.style: pouty small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 底から、取れなかったの?
lines.en: Couldn't you get it out from the bottom?
lines.style: gentle grandmother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 手が届かなくて、困っちゃった。
lines.en: My hand couldn't reach, so I was troubled.
lines.style: rueful small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 箱を回して、取ってみましょうね。
lines.en: Let's turn the box and get it out.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Oh, I got it from the bottom!
lines.style: delighted small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: よかったね。また回して遊びましょう。
lines.en: Wonderful. Let's spin it and play again.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
